body: The first line highlights the key theme of the song, alienation and the inability for people to talk to one another.
He takes comfort in venting his thoughts and emotions to the darkness, because it is the only “person” willing to listen.

I used to go off in the bathroom, because the bathroom had tiles, so it was a slight echo chamber. I’d turn on the faucet so that water would run — I like that sound, it’s very soothing to me — and I’d play. In the dark.

The ‘Darkness’ is often interpreted as a depressive  state that the singer knows quite well.  This interpretation of the opening line was used in a running gag on the American television comedy Arrested Development. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YYrwTVsckmI
